Name: Portable Dye Pots
Author: CopperSun
Description:
A day after Emily sends you the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Sewing_Machine]sewing machine[/url], she will send you another letter, this time with a set of dye pots. These pots can be used to dye your clothes anywhere you can place furniture. They work exactly like the ones at Emily's house.



Interested in making your own mods? It's easier than you think! Check out the [url=https://stardewmodding.miraheze.org/wiki/Main_Page]SDV Modding Wiki[/url] for [url=https://stardewmodding.miraheze.org/wiki/Category:Tutorials]tutorials [/url]and more!
